title: memtomem-stm: Surfaced memory data can escape the Markdown compatibility boundary (CVE-2026-77332)
description: CVE-2026-77332 is a low-severity vulnerability in memtomem-stm versions from 0.1.0 up to but not including 0.1.34. It involves untrusted long-term and working-memory fields that can introduce Markdown or HTML-compatible structures into the surfaced-memory envelope, potentially misleading structural boundaries or visually concealing content. The issue is addressed in version 0.1.34 by serializing untrusted fields as inert single-line data, validating memory identifiers, and adding an explicit untrusted-data preamble. The vulnerability does not involve remote code execution or privilege escalation and has no known exploits in the wild.
